definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own father when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My father is a company employee.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{出張中|しゅっちょうちゅう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My father is currently on a business trip.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧5{月|がつ}⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えています→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。

examples.english: When I was a child, my father taught me how to ride a bicycle, but I fell many times, so I think it was hard for him too.

notes:
{父|ちち} is the humble term for "father," used when referring to one's own father when speaking to people outside the family.

POLITENESS SYSTEM:
- {父|ちち}: my father (humble, to outsiders)
- ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧: father (neutral, direct address or others' fathers)
- ⟦お{父|とう}さま→お父さま：noentry⟧: father (very polite/formal)
- ⟦パパ→パパ：01788_papa⟧: dad (casual, childish)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {父|ちち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: Father's Day
- {父|ちち}⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧: father (formal/written)
- {父|ちち}⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: paternal side (of family)

USAGE NOTE: In casual family settings, children may call their father ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧ or ⟦パパ→パパ：01788_papa⟧. {父|ちち} is specifically for humble reference when talking to outsiders.

RELATED: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧ (mother - humble)
